routes.name: Bandcamp Direct-to-Fan Artist Store and Music Upload Route
routes.manualReviewReason: Human review is required because Bandcamp is an account-based artist-store and upload route involving profile/store setup, track or album metadata, pricing, PayPal/payment configuration, merch choices, rights confirmation, release timing and optional Bandcamp Pro decisions before publication.

routes.name: Jamendo Artists Music Licensing In-Store Promotion and Content ID Route
routes.manualReviewReason: Human review is required because Jamendo Artists is an account-based artist services route involving music upload, licensing opt-ins, in-store placement, Content ID, promotion, rights ownership, collecting-society compatibility and revenue-share terms.

routes.name: Mixcloud Creator Upload DJ Mix Radio Show and Live Stream Route
routes.manualReviewReason: Human review is required because Mixcloud is an account-based creator upload route for shows, mixes and live streams, requiring tracklist/rights review, audio-format readiness, metadata, profile setup and optional Pro/monetization decisions before publication.

routes.name: Songtradr Sync Licensing Marketplace and Artist Upload Route
routes.manualReviewReason: Human review is required because Songtradr is a JavaScript app and sync-licensing marketplace route involving account/session handling, master and publishing rights, PRO/ownership metadata, licensing fee strategy, usage permissions and possible distribution or monetization choices.

routes.name: LabelRadar Demo Contest and Label Submission Platform Route
routes.manualReviewReason: Human review is required because LabelRadar is a JavaScript-gated artist/label submission route requiring account/session handling, demo or contest selection, label fit, rights and remix-stem rules, track metadata, upload/link handling and any credit/payment-option review.
